en-US.desktop.consoleSettings.title: Console
en-US.desktop.consoleSettings.keywords: console run build test output encoding charset garbled gbk utf-8
en-US.desktop.consoleSettings.encodingHelp:
How Lithe reads output from Run, Build and Tests.
Automatic uses UTF-8. On Windows only, a line that is not valid UTF-8 falls back to GBK. A run can explicitly declare another encoding.
Choose an encoding to override automatic decoding. Changes apply to programs started afterwards.

zh-CN.desktop.consoleSettings.title: 控制台
zh-CN.desktop.consoleSettings.keywords: 控制台 运行 构建 测试 输出 编码 字符集 乱码 console encoding gbk utf-8
zh-CN.desktop.consoleSettings.encodingHelp:
Lithe 怎样读取运行、构建和测试的输出。
自动模式默认使用 UTF-8。仅 Windows 会在某一行不是合法 UTF-8 时尝试 GBK；运行也可以显式声明其他编码。
选择具体编码会覆盖自动判断。修改后对之后启动的程序生效。
